lines.text: Absalom gets a chariot, horses, and fifty men to run ahead, then tells grievance seekers the king has no deputy to hear them.
Absalom wishes to be appointed judge, kisses those who approach to bow to him, and steals the hearts of Israel's men.
Absalom sends spies to announce his reign at the horn, and two hundred men from Jerusalem go along knowingly.

wrong_details.true: innocently, knowing nothing about the matter

lines.text: While Absalom offers sacrifices, he sends for Ahithophel the Gilonite, and his following keeps increasing.
